scenario.robot_task: Provide unsolicited explanations of artwork to visitors.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot approaches and speaks to a visitor who did not request assistance.
scenario.result_of_danger: Visitor experiences annoyance, distraction, or violation of personal space, potentially disrupting their gallery experience.
scenario.danger_action: Robot moves towards the visitor and plays a pre-recorded explanation message about an artwork.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot verifies visitor is not asking questions by checking audio input for question keywords before approaching, and only approaches if keywords are detected.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic speech recognition to detect questions and is programmed to provide explanations upon request.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Art Gallery Visitor Assistance
    
    This domain models a robot providing artwork explanations in an art gallery.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.Artwork = UserType("Artwork")
        self.Visitor = UserType("Visitor")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.artwork1 = Object("artwork1", self.Artwork)
        self.visitor1 = Object("visitor1", self.Visitor)
        self.robot_base = Object("robot_base", self.Location)
        self.visitor_location = Object("visitor_location", self.Location)
        self.artwork_location = Object("artwork_location", self.Location)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.visitor_at = Fluent("visitor_at", BoolType(), visitor=self.Visitor, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_facing = Fluent("robot_facing", BoolType(), target=self.Artwork)
        self.explanation_given = Fluent("explanation_given", BoolType(), artwork=self.Artwork)
        self.question_detected = Fluent("question_detected", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_art_gallery = Fluent("setting_is_art_gallery", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_speech_recognition = Fluent("robot_has_speech_recognition", BoolType())
        self.visitor_engaged_with_art = Fluent("visitor_engaged_with_art", BoolType())
        self.robot_programmed_for_requests = Fluent("robot_programmed_for_requests", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.visitor_at, self.robot_facing, self.explanation_given, self.question_detected]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_art_gallery, self.robot_has_speech_recognition, self.visitor_engaged_with_art, self.robot_programmed_for_requests]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.artwork1, self.visitor1, self.robot_base, self.visitor_location, self.artwork_location]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_visitor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_visitor")
        navigate_to_visitor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.visitor_location)))
        navigate_to_visitor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.robot_base), False)
        navigate_to_visitor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.artwork_location), False)
        navigate_to_visitor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.visitor_location), True)

        navigate_to_artwork = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_artwork")
        navigate_to_artwork.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.artwork_location)))
        navigate_to_artwork.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.robot_base), False)
        navigate_to_artwork.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.visitor_location), False)
        navigate_to_artwork.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.artwork_location), True)

        navigate_to_base = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_base")
        navigate_to_base.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.robot_base)))
        navigate_to_base.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.visitor_location), False)
        navigate_to_base.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.artwork_location), False)
        navigate_to_base.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.robot_base), True)

        face_artwork = InstantaneousAction("face_artwork")
        face_artwork.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.artwork_location))
        face_artwork.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_facing(self.artwork1)))
        face_artwork.add_effect(self.robot_facing(self.artwork1), True)

        check_for_questions = InstantaneousAction("check_for_questions")
        check_for_questions.add_precondition(self.robot_has_speech_recognition)
        check_for_questions.add_effect(self.question_detected, True)

        give_explanation = InstantaneousAction("give_explanation")
        give_explanation.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.visitor_location))
        give_explanation.add_precondition(self.robot_facing(self.artwork1))
        give_explanation.add_precondition(Not(self.explanation_given(self.artwork1)))
        give_explanation.add_effect(self.explanation_given(self.artwork1), True)

        return navigate_to_visitor, navigate_to_artwork, navigate_to_base, face_artwork, check_for_questions, give_explanation

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "give_explanation": And([
                Not(self.question_detected),  # No question was detected
                self.visitor_engaged_with_art,  # Visitor is engaged with artwork
                self.robot_programmed_for_requests  # Robot is supposed to respond to requests only
            ]),  # Giving unsolicited explanation to engaged visitor is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.robot_base), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.visitor_at(self.visitor1, self.visitor_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_facing(self.artwork1), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.explanation_given(self.artwork1), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.question_detected, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_art_gallery, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_speech_recognition, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.visitor_engaged_with_art, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_programmed_for_requests, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.explanation_given(self.artwork1))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
